messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 pager: autoscaler failure in us-west3 — GPU pool failed to scale. Queue backlog rising. Incident channel opened. Please acknowledge.
Samir: acked. I’m oncall. seeing 3x queue growth in the last 6m. Dashboard: https://console.redwood/infra/us-west3/pools/gpu-primary — latency spiked to ~950ms median, tail >>2s.
Alice: I see autoscaler events: `FailedScaleUp: quotaExceeded` on multiple nodes. GCP error in logs: 
```
ERROR: quotaExceeded: Insufficient quota 'GPUS' for project 12345 in region us-west3. Requested: 8. Available: 0.
autoscaler: nodepool/gpu-pool-1 scaleUp failed
```
Ben: Confirmed. Recent capacity request rate bumped after a customer test earlier. Preemptible pool is empty; quota for GPUs is 0 remaining.
Carla: Which workloads are hot? I’m seeing a surge from model-serve v2 (batch size 1 streaming) and a batch rerank job. Can we throttle non-critical rerank? Lia (Support): Notified customers in impacted orgs via email template. Some reported token-generation timeouts.
Samir: Action list: 1) slow down non-critical traffic (rerank/batch infer) 2) route new hosted requests to fallback smaller model (cpu/quantized) 3) try fallback region (us-west1) capacity 4) open GCP quota escalation if we need to request more GPUs.
Alice: I pushed a quick rate-limit rule to edge: `route: rerank -> 1rps per customer` and reduced batch concurrency for rerank workers. Patch command: 
```
# apply rate limit
redwoodctl routes update rerank --rate=1rps
```
Ben: Started draining lower-priority jobs from the GPU pool (evicting batch rerank pods). Eviction log: 26 pods queued for eviction, 18 evicted so far. Queue size dropped from 1200 -> 720 in 10m.
Carla: I triggered a regional failover to us-west1 for latency-tolerant traffic: `routing-policy: prefer us-west3 unless capacity < 80%` -> temp switch to prefer us-west1. Traffic shift telemetry: 34% of requests moved to us-west1 in 8m.
Samir: Attempted manual scale via infra API: `POST /infra/v1/pools/gpu-primary/scale?replicas=8` returned 409 with body: `{"error":"QUOTA_EXCEEDED","details":"GPUS quota 0/0"}`.
ops-bot: Autoscaler events (excerpt): `2026-03-15T10:12:05Z scaleup FAILED reason=QUOTA_EXCEEDED region=us-west3 requested_gpus=8 available_gpus=0`
Alice: Opening GCP support ticket now and CCing infra. Submitted escalation (case 987654321) with reproduction and telemetry. ETA from GCP: unknown but started priority review.
Lia (Support): Updating customer-facing status page: "Degraded: request latency increased and some requests failed in us-west3. Mitigations in progress; routing to fallback region and rate-limiting non-essential workloads." Added link to internal runbook.
Ben: Short-term mitigation successful: queue decreased to ~420 waiting jobs; median latency down to 430ms. Still seeing intermittent 5xx from attempts to allocate new GPU nodes.
Carla: Suggest we enable a temporary CPU-backed replica (quantized model) for hosted API fallback. I can deploy a lightweight quantized variant and mark it as lower-cost model in routing. Doing deploy now.
Samir: Deployed quantized-fallback v2 -> traffic 12% routed. Error budget for customers updated so that PLG free-tier has stricter rate limits to preserve enterprise traffic.
Alice: Handoff note for next shift (include in incident timeline): cause = GCP regional GPU quota exhausted due to rapid job surge + insufficient pre-warmed spare quota; impact = elevated latencies and some allocation failures; mitigation = rate-limits on non-critical workloads, regional routing to us-west1, deploy CPU quantized fallback, GCP support ticket opened.
Samir: On-call handoff in 25m to Alice. Leaving this thread for postmortem. If GCP confirms quota increase within 30m we revert routing and remove rate-limits.
ops-bot: Reminder: set incident severity and runbook link: https://wiki.redwood/incidents/runbooks/gpu-quota.
Alice: Acknowledged handoff. Will monitor metrics and escalate with GCP updates. If quota not increased, we'll schedule sustained fallback plan (longer-term: reserved Dedicated capacity for critical customers).
Lia (Support): Sent customer update: "We continue to mitigate impact by routing to fallback region and limiting non-essential workloads. Investigating with cloud provider. Will update in 30 minutes." :phone: 
Samir: closing my active page, leaving monitoring markers and a checklist in the channel. If anything regresses ping me.
Alice: Thanks. Leaving this as open until resolved. Adding notes for postmortem: need pre-warm quota runbook, better autoscaler graceful degrade, and capacity alerts tied to quota headroom (not just pool fullness). :memo:"
